card_summary: PKD-on-PKD catalog for The Man in the High Castle: 39 detected title mentions across 7 PKD-authored writings. The references cluster in letters (24), primary text (15), and the detail page shows each source document with its surrounding context.
page_summary:
This section gathers PKD's own mentions of The Man in the High Castle across PKD-authored primary writings in the archive. The catalog records 39 detected title mentions in 7 PKD-authored documents. 

The represented source types here include letters (24), primary text (15). The heaviest source documents are Claudia Bush Letters (15), The Selected Letters of Philip K. Dick: 1972-1973 (6), Selected Stories of Philip K. Dick (6). 

Nearby language repeatedly turns on time, tears, 1960, and 1964. 

The mention list is organized by source document so readers can move directly from each remark to the underlying text.
